# Maldives HPA originals

Captured from Ministry of Health public pages on 2026-11-17:

- `monthly_index.html`: https://health.gov.mv/en/publications?search=monthly
- `monthly_202408.html`: https://health.gov.mv/en/publications/monthly-cd-report-august-2024
- `hpa_monthly_202408.pdf`: https://health.gov.mv/storage/uploads/0wNNyBwA/hvdpwbbo.pdf

The PDF is an HPA monthly communicable disease report. Figure 2 prints current
2024 monthly case counts on bars alongside historical comparison lines. Tests
read printed vector glyphs only, never estimate values from chart heights.
Atoll incidence figures on page 1 remain outside this count contract. Public
weekly dengue reports and a public SIDAS API have not been verified.

Historical originals for December 2022; February and December 2023; and
February, March, and April 2024 are listed with exact official URLs, sizes, and
SHA-256 hashes in `historical_pdf_manifest.json`. They exercise panel movement,
different disease orders, horizontal and vertical labels, image-only headings,
and individual ambiguous counts. All PDF bytes are unmodified originals from
the captured official archive.
